compatibility.notes: CFM56-7B is the exclusive and sole production engine for the Boeing 737 Next Generation family, including the -800 variant.

fleet_exposure.notes: Precise current figures unavailable. Historical data indicates a massive installed base. The 737-800 entered service in 1998, so a significant portion of the fleet is mature.

incident_signals.notes: Based on publicized high-severity events (fatal 2018 accident, 2025 multi-engine grounding). Comprehensive SDR data not publicly accessible.

regulatory_signals.notes: Emergency AD issued in 2018, updated AD issued in 2023. Sustained regulatory focus on inspection mandates.

drivers: Recurring product reliability issues (fan blades, premature removals)
Reputational and regulatory burden from failures
supplier_risk.notes: No signals of financial or production disruption found. Risk is operational/reputational based on product performance.

primary_drivers: Recent signals of premature unscheduled removals
repair_risk_assessment.notes: Outlook is qualitative. Recent operator groundings (2025) indicate active near-term demand for unscheduled and inspection-related MRO.
